common.stats: unchanged full train for sampling-only trials

stages.gate: calibrate close-ready geometry B and real grasp C using original GT reach replay; strict goal-hold A requires a separate new supervised dataset branch

stages.train: 8 train episodes x 10 fixed windows, visually verified after preprocess
stages.eval: true generation with fixed seeds 42/43/44; separate val episodes

stages.comparison: equal-presentation uniform continuation from same original 10k weights and fresh optimizer

stages.proposed_gate_original_labels: 16/20 reach calibrated close-ready geometry B or achieve true grasp C; A hold is observational only
stages.proposed_gate_new_goal_hold_labels: 16/20 strict pregrasp A only if goal-hold supervision was explicitly introduced

stages.note: known 3 val diagnostic scenes excluded from claims of fresh testing

conditional_trials.H1: loss-only prefix weighting if near-horizon generated error remains limiting; retain nonzero suffix
conditional_trials.D1: 50-100 student execution episodes if expert-observation fit passes but student-state failure persists
conditional_trials.V1: native camera/resolution or observable teacher target repair if input visibility gap is confirmed
conditional_trials.X1: chunk control-age cap 30 then optionally 15, only after useful targets; do not default to 5-target truncation
conditional_trials.B1: accumulation 4 only when optimization variance evidence supports it; compare window presentations
conditional_trials.A1: local visual adaptation only after visible-input and data/label checks fail to yield sufficient fit

evaluation_truth_boundary: GT identity/pose/phase only labels or observers; never drive policy goal selection, online phase handoff or gripper triggering

new_pregrasp_thresholds.status: proposed only for separately supervised goal-hold branch; teacher verification and corresponding labels required; not a hard gate for original-label S1

evidence_boundary: Sampling exposure counts are expectations; visibility is raw-image expert-target mask area; current 3-scene probes are developmental; all plan success thresholds are untested.
